metadata.title: Failed payments, recovered on autopilot
metadata.description: Reclaim connects to your Stripe or MercadoPago account, detects failed payments in real time, and brings subscribers back with AI emails written in your voice.

hero.subtitle: Reclaim connects to your Stripe or MercadoPago account, detects failed payments in real time, and brings subscribers back with AI emails written in your voice. You don’t touch a thing.

subjects.d1: “A small hiccup with your payment — everything’s fine”
subjects.d3: “Your access is still active, update your card”

marquee.label: Plugs into the stack you already use

how.title: From failed charge to recovered revenue in three moves
how.subtitle: No dashboards to babysit, no templates to write. Reclaim runs the whole recovery loop for you.

s1.title: Connect your gateway
s1.desc: Secure OAuth with Stripe or MercadoPago. We register the webhooks for you — no code, no manual setup.

s2.title: We detect the failure instantly
s2.desc: The moment a charge fails, a recovery sequence starts: three emails on days 1, 3 and 7, written by AI in your brand’s voice.

s3.title: Subscribers come back
s3.desc: Each email links to a hosted page where they update their card in seconds — no password, no friction. You just watch revenue return.

features.title: Everything you need to stop losing subscribers
features.subtitle: Built for Spanish-speaking creators and small SaaS who bill with Stripe or MercadoPago.

ai.title: Emails in your voice, not ours
ai.desc: No generic templates. Claude writes each sequence with your brand’s tone, natively in Spanish, ready to send. You can preview every email before it goes out.
ai.subject: “A small hiccup with your payment — everything’s fine”
ai.body: Hi Diego! Your card was declined this time — it happens, banks… Your access to Tribu Fitness Pro is still active. If you want to fix it in ten seconds:

safe.title: Secure by design
safe.desc: Read-only access to what matters. Reclaim can’t move money, see full card numbers, or touch your payouts.

realtime.title: Real-time detection
realtime.desc: Gateway webhooks start recovery in under 60 seconds — before your subscriber even notices something failed.

portal.title: One-tap card update
portal.desc: A hosted, passwordless portal. Your subscriber fixes their card in seconds, from any device.

gateways.title: Stripe & MercadoPago, natively
gateways.desc: The only recovery tool built for LATAM: cards, wallets and local payment methods included.

brands.title: Multi-brand & multi-currency
brands.desc: Run several communities from one account — each with its own voice, logo and gateway.

pricing.title: It pays for itself with the first recovery
pricing.subtitle: Start free and upgrade when your community grows. Prices in USD, cancel anytime.
pricing.note: Recover a single payment and the month is already paid for.

faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.subtitle: Everything creators usually ask before connecting their gateway.

items.q: Do you need access to my Stripe or MercadoPago account?
items.a: We connect through secure OAuth. Reclaim can read invoices and register webhooks in your account, but it can’t move money, see full card numbers, or touch your payouts. You can disconnect anytime from your own dashboard.

items.q: What happens if a payment isn’t recovered?
items.a: After the third email, the sequence closes and we tell you exactly what happened. If you enable it, Reclaim can also cancel the subscription in your gateway automatically. You always keep the final say.

items.q: Are the emails really written in Spanish?
items.a: Yes — written natively in Spanish with your brand’s tone, not translated from English templates. Your subscribers read something that sounds like you, not like a billing robot.

items.q: Do my subscribers need a password to update their card?
items.a: No. Each email links to a secure, one-time hosted portal. They tap, update the card, and they’re back — the whole thing takes under a minute.

items.q: Can I cancel whenever I want?
items.a: Yes. Billing is monthly with no lock-in. Disconnect your gateway and every active sequence stops immediately — no emails are ever sent without you.

cta.title: Your next failed payment is already on its way.
cta.subtitle: Connect your gateway today and let Reclaim recover the revenue you already earned.

footer.made_for: Made for creators who’d rather create than chase payments.
